content:
We need to add CO2 to silicon slab at specified adsorption site with height ~2.0 Å. We have paths to slab CIF, CO2 CIF, and chosen_site.json. Need to read chosen_site.json to get site coordinates. Then use add_adsorbate_to_slab_text tool with slab_cif string, adsorbate_cif string, height 2.0, site coordinates.
